caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, dark brown plaque with curved and ornate edges. The plaque has a symmetrical design, featuring decorative leaf and floral patterns on both the left and right sides. In the center of the plaque, there is a large oval or circular area that encloses the stylized number “40.” On both the left and right sides of the central number, there are vertical, oval shapes that resemble candle flames or feather shapes, each contained within a circular border. The overall color scheme consists mainly of hues of brown, reddish-brown, and deep gold, giving the plaque a metallic or leather-like appearance. There are two small loops at the top of each side, suggesting a way to hang the plaque. The artwork displays shading and highlights that give a three-dimensional look to the engraved or embossed patterns and numbers.
title: Gun Rack
